buildCommand: git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /tmp/flutter && export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter config --enable-web && cd mobile && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL
